name: LE NEUF
description: Le Neuf ('Nines') is a French-Canadian trick-taking game from Quebec/Acadian communities. 3 players (4-player variant exists). 52-card deck, 13 each + 13-card 'Chômeur' spare hand. Start at 9 points, subtract to 0. Quota = 4 tricks: each trick above -1pt, below +1pt. Rotating trump cycle: Hearts-Diamonds-Clubs-Spades-No Trump. Can swap hand with Chômeur.

content.text: Le Neuf ('Nines') is a French-Canadian trick-taking game from Quebec/Acadian communities. 3 players (4-player variant exists). 52-card deck, 13 each + 13-card 'Chômeur' spare hand. Start at 9 points, subtract to 0. Quota = 4 tricks: each trick above -1pt, below +1pt. Rotating trump cycle: Hearts-Diamonds-Clubs-Spades-No Trump. Can swap hand with Chômeur.

Le Neuf is a trick-taking game from Eastern Canada, played mainly in French-speaking Quebec (as Le Neuf or Chômeur) and by Acadians in Nova Scotia, and in Newfoundland and Eastern Ontario under the name Nines. It belongs to the quota-whist family; the name refers to each player starting with 9 points.
